titulo: Quiz — The praise that reaches the kitchen
subtitulo: Both sentences need a noun in them
introPt: A traveller sends praise through to the kitchen, then gets a cold plate sorted in one flat sentence.
cenario: Mid-meal in a small taverna, one very good plate and one that came out cold.

dialogo.es: Να 'στε καλά! Θα το πω στην κουζίνα.
dialogo.pt: That's kind of you! I'll pass it on to the kitchen.
dialogo.tts: Να 'στε καλά! Θα το πω στην κουζίνα.

dialogo.pt: Right away, sorry, I'll change it for you.

perguntas.pergunta: What makes a compliment travel as far as the kitchen?
opcoes: Saying it loudly enough to be heard
Naming the dish
Leaving extra money on the table
Repeating it on the way out
perguntas.explica: Nobody can carry «everything was lovely» into a kitchen. They can carry «το ψάρι».

perguntas.pergunta: How is the sentence about the cold plate built?
opcoes: Συγγνώμη, then the fact, then stop
An apology, the fact, then a second apology
A full account of the evening so far
Say nothing and write it up later
perguntas.explica: Six words is a complete, well-formed request. The shorter it is, the faster the plate moves.

perguntas.pergunta: Politeness research describes Greek and English as pointing in different directions. Which way round?
opcoes: Both lean towards distance and non-imposition
Greek leans to distance, English to closeness
Greek leans to involvement and closeness, English to distance and non-imposition
Neither has been studied
perguntas.explica: That mismatch is why a padded, distance-keeping sentence does work the setting never asked for — and why the flat one lands as information.

perguntas.pergunta: Your compliment gets a quick «να 'στε καλά» and the person walks off. That means:
opcoes: It landed badly
The reply is short by convention and the message still goes through
You should say it again, louder
You should ask to see whoever cooked
perguntas.explica: The part that matters happens where you cannot see it. Length of reply measures how busy the room is, nothing else.

perguntas.pergunta: The strongest compliment available to you on the way out is:
opcoes: Νόστιμο
A large tip
A five-star review
Θα ξανάρθουμε σίγουρα
perguntas.explica: A room that feeds the same neighbourhood every week counts its work in the people who walk back in.
